text: RESOLVED: one eyes4s-laws module for v1.0; revisit post-1.0 only if a real consumer complains. Rationale: matches linop4s and graph4s. The theoretical cost -- an author testing one new Metric instance pulls all of eyes4s -- is an annoyance at a single version, not a blocker. Splitting into 6-7 laws artifacts multiplies the publication and CI version matrix for a speculative benefit. If it is ever split, the natural seam is kernel-laws vs the rest, because that aligns with the trace4s extraction boundary.
